ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.45:0.55 ratio of high-intensity (>200 grayscale) to low-intensity (<50 grayscale) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white high-intensity zones on the distal regions of both lobes, contrasted with a solid black low-intensity central medial region. Irregular black speckling and spots are mapped within the distal white zones, particularly on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 12% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 4 to 18 pixels; serrations are more pronounced and jagged toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a broad convex curve across the mid-lobe toward the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular pixel clusters detected; most prominent is a cluster of three concentric rings on the right lobe and several smaller high-contrast white circular scars on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark, unaligned linear pixel streaks are visible on the distal left lobe, cutting across the primary white pigmentation; smaller horizontal disruptions are visible near the lower water-line of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified clusters (barnacles) are present on the extreme distal tips and along segments of the trailing edges; multiple circular/ovoid 'target' scars (likely parasitic) are distributed across the fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique concentric 'bullseye' scar located in the upper-central region of the right lobe pigmentation.
